purpose: Provenance record for the manuscript Section 4 figures. Maps each generated source file in the analysis repository to its destination in this manuscript worktree.

hard_constraints: The intervals in Figure 8 and Tables 3-4 are Bayesian posterior predictive intervals, y_pred +/- 1.645*y_std. They are not split-conformal and must never be labelled as such.
No reader-visible element in any figure contains an internal profile or level identifier. Verified with pdftotext.
Figures are generated from frozen checkpoints. No model is refit.
Every decimal shown in the manuscript prose, tables, and captions carries exactly three decimal places, while source files and in-code assertions retain full precision.

section_4_1_generator.status: Working-tree generator created for the manuscript package and not committed in the analysis repository because that repository contains unrelated user changes.
section_4_1_generator.data_filter: station TUKU, sections S1-S6, predictor bayesian_ridge, protocol rolling_blocked, model_mode local, and only folds containing six distinct months; 828 rows, 138 per section, 23 complete cycles
section_4_1_generator.interval_method: Bayesian posterior predictive, y_pred +/- 1.645*y_std from BayesianRidge.predict(..., return_std=True)
section_4_1_generator.assertions: The generator requires 23 complete cycles and 828 rows, and reproduces pooled coverage 0.7801932367149759 and mean interval width 0.9043360111248384 at full precision.
